name: JellyWrapped
description: JellyWrapped records each user's plays and builds a yearly recap, played as stories: time spent, artists, tracks, albums, movies, series, listening habits and persona. Users can share it as an image or through a public link. Available in English and French.
overview: A yearly Wrapped-style recap of your music, movies and series
